voices.name: l00
voices.text: Have people been telling you lately <#0.2#> that you've changed?
voices.caption: Have people been telling you lately that you've changed?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: You don't have to be hurt <#0.3#> by those words.
voices.caption: You don't have to be hurt by those words.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: It's a sign you're walking out <#0.2#> of a game someone else set up for you.
voices.caption: It's a sign you're walking out of a game someone else set up for you.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: When a caterpillar becomes a butterfly, <#0.2#> it can't stay the way it was.
voices.caption: When a caterpillar becomes a butterfly, it can't stay the way it was.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: People want you not to change <#0.2#> because they're still inside the same game.
voices.caption: People want you not to change because they're still inside the same game.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: If they say you've changed, <#0.3#> you're doing it right.
voices.caption: If they say you've changed, you're doing it right.
